description: The Special Rapporteur on torture's May 2026 report notes 94 Palestinians died in custody from October 2023 through August 2025, acknowledging a lack of transparency about causes of death. A review of 10 postmortem examinations found signs of physical abuse in five of them.
energy_note: Ninety-four deaths, and half the autopsies reviewed show abuse.

description: Head of orthopaedics at al-Shifa and a professor of orthopaedic medicine. Detained 19 December 2023 during an attack on Al-Awda Hospital in northern Gaza and taken to Sde Teiman. Fellow detainee Dr Khalid Hamouda said he was beaten for days, his ribs broken, until he could no longer walk unaided. Four months later he was transferred to Ofer Prison in the West Bank.
energy_note: A professor of orthopaedics, with broken ribs, unable to stand.

description: Testimony collected by the Israeli rights group HaMoked describes him arriving at Ofer severely battered, naked from the waist down and unable to stand, thrown into the yard and left helpless. As a fellow prisoner helped him to a cell, screams were heard; minutes later prisoners were heard declaring him dead. The Palestinian Civil Affairs Committee said he died on 19 April, aged 50. His body remains withheld. Israel accused him of being a terrorist; like most detainees at Sde Teiman and Ofer he was never charged with any offence. The UN Special Rapporteur on the OPT expressed concern over his death, emphasising the likelihood of sexual violence as part of his torture.
energy_note: Fifty years old, never charged, body not returned.

aspect: EXAMPLE - he was not the only one
description: Dr Iyad Al Rantisi also reportedly died in detention as a result of torture and ill-treatment. Dr Khaled Al Serr of the Nasser Medical Complex survived six months following the same route from Sde Teiman to Ofer, describing regular beatings including to intimate areas, and calling the treatment humiliating.
energy_note: A second doctor dead, a third who came back.

aspect: The body withheld is a second, continuing harm
description: Where remains are not returned there is no burial, no funeral, no grave and no point at which the death becomes a fact the family can act on. It converts a bereavement into an indefinite open state.

aspect: Scale of the detained population, for context
description: OHCHR figures cited in the 2026 Secretary-General's report indicate more than 9,000 Palestinians remain imprisoned, including over 4,000 in administrative detention. Israel continues to deny UN investigators access to detention facilities and to Gaza.
energy_note: Nine thousand held, and no inspector admitted.
